rounds.text: Karamtara Engineering demonstrates exceptional operational momentum, evidenced by a 33% compounded sales growth over five years and a staggering 85% compounded profit growth over the same period [E13, E16]. This performance is not merely historical, as the company continues to deliver 37% sales growth and 75% profit growth in the trailing twelve months [E15, E18]. The business is highly efficient at converting its earnings into actual cash, with a cash conversion ratio of 2.95x and operating cash flow representing 152% of operating profit [E25, E28]. Furthermore, the company is actively investing in its future, as evidenced by a 147.4% increase in capital work in progress [E32]. While the sector tailwind provides a supportive backdrop for this expansion [E50, E51], the company is significantly outperforming its peers with a 22.25% ROCE compared to the 12.9% sector benchmark [E9]. Conceded: the stock trades at a high P/E of 51 and a DCF analysis suggests a negative margin of safety [E1, E38]. Despite these valuation concerns, the company’s ability to consistently grow profits at rates far exceeding the sector median of 22.1% underscores its underlying strength [E18, E52].
